_about: M3-ENV-03: the two lighting sub-frames of the Pemakar kit preview (pemakar.md §0; color script ch05). `dusk` is ch05_dusk (19:05, the first boats; the afterglow WNW behind the plume), `night` is the color script's ch05 festival frame (20:00). Lights name nodes under the preview's Lights; a sun or fill is given by the elevation and compass azimuth (0 north, 90 east) of its source. lamp_scale multiplies every placed lamp's energy; far_lights_energy and sea_lights_energy are the energies of the distant festival lights and of the boats drifting on the sea; glimmer is hymn_glimmer (glimmer_held, linear; its alpha opens the sea-glow gate).
